name: extremis
description: Capability layer for agents: 70 skills and workflows, 10 specialist agents and 45 permission-gated tools with executable verification, loaded on demand over MCP, plus a finder for public skills.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, activate, run and verify reusable agent capabilities.
interface.longDescription: A gateway skill plus the EXTREMIS MCP server. Plans a task across 70 capabilities and workflows, briefs 10 specialist agents (code reviewer, security auditor, debugger, AI engineer and more), loads only the selected instructions, runs permission-gated tools and checks results before reporting done.
